decision_reason: Both methods meet the prospective development gate and tie on support coverage and complete questions. BM25 has the higher MRR@5 under the frozen ordering.
retained_development_failures: Both methods miss required measured SARS-CoV-2 accuracy support for dev-raptor-02 while retrieving manufacturer claims.
Both return candidates for both no-answer questions. The COACH unmeasured-adherence limitation is not retrieved at five; one of two declared no-answer context quotes is covered.
held_out_authorization: Evaluate only BM25 with unchanged frozen parameters, gold, metrics and thresholds. Do not tune on held-out failures.
limits: Small three-article agent-authored software pilot; not clinical validation.
Question-level split shares documents and some passages; no document-level generalization claim.
Non-exhaustive support labels may omit alternative valid passages.
No established multiple-report study; multi-passage questions do not validate cross-report retrieval.
